source: Rob (The Pool Shack), Basecamp 'Automation Snapshots', 19/10/2026; Frank asked to apply it on 20/10. Missed-call SMS 1 is Rob's text verbatim. The others were written by us from his notes (general wording beyond weekly cleaning, no urgency, don't assume they hired another company, welcome per customer type) and go to Rob for review. Quote Sent texts and the weekly welcome stay as they were (Rob liked them).

messages.workflow: Missed New Lead - Initial SMS Follow-up
messages.text: Hi [First Name], this is The Pool Shack. Sorry we missed your call! We're currently assisting other customers but will get back to you as soon as possible. Feel free to reply with a brief description of what you need help with.

[First Name],
